choices.reason: No preregistration or primary outcome is reported, and the abstract presents several creativity outcomes without prioritising one. Participant-level statistics, AI-arm choice and full-sample coverage do not distinguish the supplied candidates, and the session rule cannot select one outcome (the pooled summaries in Table 4 are outside the candidate set), so no rule yields a unique choice.
choices.locator: PDF p. 4, Section 2, research question 1 (quote); p. 1, Abstract; pp. 8-9, Tables 4-5.
choices.quote: Creativity was evaluated along five dimensions: fluency, flexibility, originality, elaboration, and novelty.
